title: Fractions and Rational Numbers on a Number Line (Day 110)
description: Understand a fraction as a coordinate mapped across a spatial dimension.
concept: A fraction represents equal parts of a whole unit.
bullets: The denominator defines how many equal intervals divide the segment from 0 to 1.
The numerator represents how many steps are counted from the origin point.
A value of 4/4 lines up perfectly with the integer 1.
cross_reference: Mark 6:41 — And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves.
